useUnit: Annual-average percentage reporting any marijuana use in prior year/month; includes vaping. Age18+ is not age21+ legal-adult population.
intervalMeaning: State95%Bayesian credible intervals from small-area estimation; national row uses design-based confidence intervals. Not draw ranges for world demand levels.
coverage: 50states+DC,nationaland4regions;territories not covered.2023–2024noninstitutionalizedsurvey population;method/coverage exclusions must be retained.

california2024.limits: Californiaonly,not otherstates;point estimate noCI supplied in summary. Rounded1.4/3.8 differs from rounded40%;do not claim exact equality.

spendingGap: Summary read does not supply a verified per-user retail-spending range. Wholesale production value is not household retail expenditure. Need direct retail sales plus matched purchasers/quantities/prices; use prevalence alone cannot supply spend.
goldenRule: Actual legal receipts must emerge from purchases and taxable law terms on real modeled base. These empirical levels only calibrate/test mechanisms;do not draw revenue/spending/use levels.
